equivalence_boundaries: The density branch is an effective refracted-gravity control and is not a discovery.
The acceleration branch overlaps known low-acceleration polarization and MOND-like phenomenology; the vacuum interpretation is not established.
The zero-environment subfamily of the nonlocal branch can be behaviorally equivalent to an acceleration-polarization cell and is not counted as a distinct historical idea.
The GEMA constitutive contrast is not a causal spacetime kernel, and fitting it cannot establish Mashhoon-style nonlocal gravity.

The frustrated dual-invariant branch differs from Item 30's low-potential AND low-density response by using invariant disagreement, but it is only a potentially new synthesis and carries no novelty claim.
All exact parameter signatures and failure causes remain recorded so rewrites cannot inflate creativity.
